332037.title: The combinatorial injection conjecture for dominance order on compositions
332037.history_check: exact-ID and topic-keyword search of prior lane results/summaries/ledger: no prior disposition (outputs/history-*.txt)
332037.disposition: Smyth Conjecture 1.5 is FALSE at (A,a,B,b)=(3,20,2,19): the down-set D generated by 8 explicit partitions of 39 contains the rearranged concatenations of 1137 elements of U^3_19 x U^2_20 but of only 1134 elements of U^3_20 x U^2_19; any dominance-decreasing map sends the former set into the latter, so no injection exists. Pattern persists for (3,b+1,2,b), b=19..43 (computed, not proved). Minimal in all scanned ranges.
332037.attempts: Type-level exact max flow (Hall) over A<=10, a<=10, a+b<=16 (3900 cases, no failure); Robin-Hood network flow scans listed in candidate-332037/PROOF.md section 4; proof routes (pairwise Robin Hood, one-step equal-size lemma, tail-swap map) tested and refuted; B=1, A=B, a=b cases proved true.
332037.remaining: Lean compile of UNCOMPILED draft candidate-332037/Smyth1512Refutation.lean (root/Sol); read published Order 35 (2018) body to confirm Conjecture 1.5 is still stated there (paywalled, unread); independent review.
